messages:
Eli: thanks for joining the follow-up thread from today's all-hands :wave: post any leftover strategy questions here.
Maya: quick framing — mission unchanged: predictable, economical inference across hosted/dedicated/private. we win on operational guarantees.
Kai: curious about messaging: should we prioritize 'cost predictability' or 'deployment flexibility' externally?
Jordan: both but context matters. for platform teams lead with predictability+observability. for enterprises lead with private + compliance.
Sana: competitor Q: big cloud endpoints claim simplicity. how do we explain why teams should pick Redwood?
Maya: call out production features clouds don't prioritize: KV/prefix caching, rollout policies, token-level cost breakdowns, and verified performance profiles.
Priya: product ask: will Optimize ever auto-apply quantization?
Maya: roadmap: suggestions now, safe auto-apply as an opt-in later.
AllHandsBot: poll "Which capability should we highlight in the next blog?" options: 1) Dedicated SLA 2) Optimize recommendations 3) Private onboarding 4) Observability. React 1/2/3/4.
Eli: we'll synthesize and publish a short FAQ + slide deck for GTM by EOW. keep questions here.
